newsitem.title: USA: HL&P 1,250 MW South Texas nuke boosts power.
newsitem.headline: HL&P 1,250 MW South Texas nuke boosts power.

text.p: Houston Lighting & Power Co's (HL&P) 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear unit 2 has boosted power in preparation for resumed electricity production, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The unit was operating at 29 percent of capacity and was "holding for calorimetrics," the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
South Texas 2 had been operating at only one percent of power as of early Tuesday.
HL&P officials have said the unit is expected to resume power output on Feb 28.
South Texas 2 was shut Feb 8 for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The adjoining 1,250 megawatt South Texas nuclear unit 1 was operating at full capacity as of early Wednesday, the NRC said.
Houston Lighting & Power is a subsidiary of Houston Industries Inc.
